name: Mistral API Free mode
amount: $10 of API credit a month on the Free plan, shared across Studio, the API and Vibe Code
summary: Mistral's Free plan: API keys with no credit card and $10 of API credit a month, shared with Studio and Vibe Code; usage stops when it runs out unless pay-as-you-go is on. Per-model limits still apply (Mistral Small and Medium have a free limit of 0 in our tests). Mistral may use Free-plan inputs and outputs to train its models. The free models are in the directory and tested daily.
source_note: mistral.ai/pricing (Free: "$10 /mo in API credits") and docs.mistral.ai (Usage and limits), checked 2026-10-03; help.mistral.ai (data use in Free mode); our own requests with a Free-mode key, 2026-09-29.

changes.text: Mistral's pricing page now describes the Free plan's API use as $10 of API credit a month (shared with Studio and Vibe Code), instead of an unpublished monthly allowance.
